Learned by the seventh lead, added to the lists below: (aa) EVERY one of the four lanes failed GitHub at its first push on something a whole run on the machine would have shown: so the builder's LAST act (or a small-fix helper's) is `npm run test:units` and the whole browser chain in chunks of six, BEFORE the first push, not after the first failure (a trip to GitHub costs 30 to 45 minutes; scoring-plays and scoring-screen take five minutes each: give them a chunk of their own, and a command stops at 600 seconds, so `test:units` is run as two halves or left to GitHub); (ab) a lane with a migration regenerates the schema types file (`npm run db:types`) after EVERY edit of the migration, and gives a new core event handler its case in `packages/database/src/isolation` (the isolation-coverage test); (ac) a pending decision's table row has exactly as many cells as its table: no `|` inside a cell; (ad) a browser test that finds a form by "has a select" or a name of three letters in a whole page breaks when a neighbour changes: find things by their own mark; (ae) Next.js merges a page's head SHALLOWLY: a layout's or page's own `robots` replaces the one above it (the test copy's mark was lost that way); `apps/web/src/app/[league]/robots-mark.test.ts` now forbids it under a league; (af) `wait-for-github.mjs` in the loop of eight tries ends with exit code 1 on a PASS when the command ends with `grep -q FAILED … && …`: read the file's last line, not the exit code; (ag) the lead may merge the build branch into a lane itself when the conflict is one import list, and may regenerate a generated file; anything more is a helper's; (ah) `SendMessage` to a running helper adds an item to its brief without a new session (used once, for a failure GitHub reported mid-round).

Learned by the sixth lead, added to the list below: (s) a cloud machine's clone is SHALLOW and may be hours behind: `git fetch --deepen=400 origin build/stage-1` and `git merge --ff-only origin/build/stage-1` before reading STATUS.md, then `npm ci`; (t) a lane that gives an admin area its first screen takes that area out of THREE pins: `apps/web/src/features/unreleased/unreleased-page.test.ts`, `adminPlaceholders` in `tests/browser/nothing-unfinished-test.mjs`, and a new READ is listed as a read in `apps/web/src/server/activity-messages.test.ts`: say so in the brief (2.56 lost a trip to GitHub); (u) a lane that changes a table many tests read (or adds screens) has its last helper run `npm run test:units` once and the whole browser chain in chunks of six before the last push: both lanes that did passed GitHub at the next try; (v) a twin that fails where the lane passed on the same commit is an unreliable test: push with `--times=3`, wait on the lane and `-again2`, land with `--twin …-again2`, and write the test on the polish list; (w) NEVER let a helper `pkill` by name: the publishing helper killed another lane's browser; briefs say "stop only the server you started, by its own process id"; (x) a wait started before a fix round keeps running and follows the branch's newest commit: check it with `pgrep -f 'wait-for-github.mjs lane/<name>'` after the push instead of starting a second; (y) the first-look page can be published by the lead with ONE call once a helper of the same session has read it (`Artifact` publish, `file_path` `.local/look/index.html`, `url`); a Sonnet helper judged a sideways scroll as "cut off": tell it what the design is; (z) the working directory of the lead's shell follows the last lane it pushed: every command starts with `cd` to an absolute path.

Learned, not yet rules elsewhere: (a) a lane that adds a page, a route, a field, a table or a helper under `tests/browser` enters it where the build pins them BEFORE its first push: the page-step rows in `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` for every kind of person (`npm run test:web`), the harmful-text browser test (it must open every page route and type into every free-text field), `HELPERS` in `scripts/web-browser-chain.mjs`, and it runs the whole browser chain in its folder in chunks of six files: say so in every builder's brief (2.49 and 2.207 each lost a trip to GitHub); (b) a test on the build branch requires every database port to take `coreEventHandlers` (`apps/web/src/server/database-event-handlers.test.ts`); (c) after two lanes land that touch the same sentence or list, run the unit tests of both in the main folder; (d) `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs` pins the number of rows of the T4 table; (e) a pinned start-up sentence in `apps/web/src/server/container.test.ts` names the first table the owner login holds; (f) at most four or five items a helper, "count them"; a helper told to leave nothing in the background reports once; (g) the app's check sometimes refuses a helper one command (`npm run test:web` once tonight): the helper says so and GitHub's machines run it; the lead never runs for a helper what the helper was refused; (h) the stop check of the app complains about uncommitted files while a helper is mid-work in a lane: leave them to the helper; (i) publishing to an artifact needs one read of its page first (25 thousand tokens): a Sonnet helper republishes; (j) a test fixture whose name ends in `.pem` never reaches GitHub; (l) a builder who finds a gap in the PRODUCT while proving a procedure (2.207 found that nothing published a league) reports it; the lead opens a step for it at once on the same test's line; (m) every test and seed that publishes a league now goes through the must-fix checks inside `setLeagueStatus` (a contact email; for a league with under-18s the names choice saved); (n) when two open lanes touch the same browser test or list, the second cannot land after the first: land one, merge the build branch into the other with a small-fix helper (it finds real faults: 2.97's 'Use another account' broke on 2.163's sign-out), push twice again; so open lanes that do not share files, or land in the order that needs one merge; (o) `land-lane.mjs --tests` takes only vitest files the root config includes (`packages/database/src/<folder>/...`, `apps/web/...`): a wrong path undoes the landing; (p) raise the pinned T4 row count (`tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs`) in a commit made RIGHT BEFORE the landing that folds the row, never earlier (an early raise breaks every other landing); (q) a wait of four tries is too short when six branches are queued: use eight; a wait started before a fix round ends 'NOT PUSHED' when the helper commits: start waits after the last push; (r) a confirming look found a Medium after a High was fixed (2.224): keep doing them; (k) reading the meter: three points of the week bought, tonight, two hours of three lanes with the lead (19% at 22:06, 21% at 23:58, 23% at 01:29: four points bought five landed steps, one of them built from nothing).
